The killer in Friday the thirteenth... was never Jason.
Summer, nineteen fifty-seven. Camp Crystal Lake.
A quiet boy named Jason goes into the water.
The counselors who should be watching him... aren't.
His mother, Pamela, loses everything that day.
The camp moves on. The town forgets. She doesn't.
For years she carries it. The grief. The blame. And a voice in her head that sounds like her son.
So when the camp tries to reopen... Pamela comes back.
And one by one... the counselors disappear.
That's the twist of the original film. The first killer... was a mother.
Jason didn't pick up the machete until the sequels.
Peacock's Crystal Lake tells her story. How a mom becomes a monster. So... who's really to blame?
